failure_replayed.latched_error: encoder receipt clock mapping residual exceeded

formula: residual_ns = (serial_received_ns - board_us*1000) - (anchor_serial_received_ns - anchor_board_us*1000); configured receipt_delay cancels in this relative residual
interpretation: One transient relative board-to-serial-host-receipt delay exceeded the fixed mapping residual gate. The following recorded packet returned within budget; no reset/reanchor was applied. The guard is independent of downstream stream receipt/processing time.
not_established: Whether USB buffering, serial reader scheduling, or another pre-receipt host effect caused the delay.
Absolute sensor acquisition/exposure latency; the22ms delay is assumed and cancels from this residual calculation.
Calibration accuracy or any control eligibility.
native_camera_scope: The clock-map rejection does not itself change native counts, board timestamps, camera geometry, or rig health; independent diagnostics may continue with their own validity/guard checks. Fused shadow remains invalid after the latch.
